philippines.title: Lotto results: No jackpot winner in Sept. 15 draws
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines—No ticket won the jackpots in the Ultra Lotto 6/58, Super Lotto 6/49 and Lotto 6/42 draws on Tuesday, Sept. 15, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office. The Ultra Lotto 6/58 winning combination was 53-49-56-01-18-50 for a jackpot of ₱299.25 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. For Super Lotto 6/49, the winning combination was 23-42-33-15-14-30, with a jackpot of ₱25.17 million. PCSO said there was no jackpot winner. The Lotto 6/42 combination was 32-02-05-13-06-27 for a jackpot of ₱41.87 million. No ticket won the top prize. READ: Lotto Results Today – September 15, 2026 Minor games Draw schedule […]...

philippines.title: Pre-shaded BARMM ballots go to Comelec main office for probe
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — The pre-shaded ballots flagged in Maluso, Basilan, during the first Bangsamoro parliamentary elections will be brought to the Commission on Elections (Comelec) main office for investigation, the poll body said Tuesday. The move was ordered in a memorandum issued by Comelec Executive Director Teopisto Elnas to Senior Staff Monitor in Basilan Director Vergil Juan Soriano and Acting Provincial Election Supervisor Atty.
